scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Backend && npm run build --prefix Frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.lint: (cd Frontend && npm run lint) && (cd Backend && npm run lint)
scripts.format: concurrently -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run format --prefix Backend" "npm run format --prefix Frontend"
scripts.format:check: concurrently -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run format:check --prefix Backend" "npm run format:check --prefix Frontend"
